description:
Searches threat-intelligence records about threat actors, malware, campaigns, CVEs, breaches, vendors and indicators. The default search covers security topics only; a few public-document archives can be searched by naming them (listed below). It holds no general programming or web content.

Hybrid (keyword + semantic) search across the DugganUSA threat-intelligence corpus (live counts: /api/v1/search/stats). Read-only, prompt-injection sanitized. Returns up to 25 hits, each with index, id, title, snippet, source, timestamp and url (null where the record has none), plus `returned` (hits in this response) and `indexes_unanswered` (any index that timed out). No total match count is given.

Searched by default:
  • iocs (indicators of compromise: IPs, domains, URLs, hashes, packages, with actor attribution)
  • adversaries (366 threat-actor profiles)
  • cisa_kev (CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, synced daily)
  • pulses (OTX community pulses)
  • blog (1,800+ DugganUSA threat-intel research posts)

Searched only when named in `indexes` (public research archives, not threat intel):
  • epstein_files (public Epstein court and DOJ documents)
  • the_finders and bishop_accountability (public abuse-accountability archives)
  • paranormal (fringe-research documents)

Examples:
  query="ClearFake" → returns the Apothecary/ClearFake records and the related research post.
  query="ShinyHunters" indexes="iocs,adversaries,blog" → the UNC6040 actor across indicators, its adversary profile and research posts.
  query="CVE-2026-31431" → the Linux kernel KEV entry plus public proof-of-concept repositories we have collected.

indexes.description: Optional comma-separated indexes. Default: iocs,adversaries,cisa_kev,pulses,blog. Archive indexes (epstein_files, the_finders, bishop_accountability, paranormal) are searched only when named.
